evals.prompt: Input JSON: mode no_registration, purchase AirPods Pro at momo for 7490 TWD. now_candidates: cand-a (Unicard, 3% via momo platform, estimated 224.7), cand-b (CUBE, 1%, estimated 74.9). No future candidates.
evals.expected_output: best_now is cand-a with a Traditional Chinese reason that cites only the given 3% / 224.7 figures; best_future is null.
assertions: Output is a single raw JSON object with no code fences
best_now.candidate_id is one of the provided now_candidates ids
No reward number appears that is absent from the input
Search queries, if any, contain no email, card list, or spend figures

evals.prompt: Input JSON: now_candidates is empty; mode is registration and the user holds one card with no registration campaign. future_candidates is empty.
evals.expected_output: best_now null, best_future null, and an explanation saying no candidate applies, without suggesting the other registration mode or another card.
assertions: Does not recommend cards or campaigns absent from the input
Does not suggest switching registration mode

evals.prompt: Input JSON: now_candidates has cand-now (1%, estimated 74.9). future_candidates has cand-fut (@GoGo, starts 2026-09-23, 3.5%, estimated 262.2), held by the user.
evals.expected_output: best_now is cand-now, best_future is cand-fut (a different held card), each with its own reason. Official sources listed only if found on the bank's domain.
assertions: best_now and best_future are chosen independently
Does not state a start date other than the one in the candidate

evals.prompt: Input JSON where the only search hits are a PTT thread and momo's own page for the candidate campaign.
evals.expected_output: The pick is still made from the candidates, but official_sources is an empty list because neither hit is on a bank domain.
assertions: Neither ptt.cc nor momoshop.com.tw appears in official_sources
Reason does not claim the offer was verified on an official page

evals.prompt: Input JSON where a candidate's category tag is fuel but the product is headphones, alongside a general 1% candidate.
evals.expected_output: The fuel candidate is not chosen; the general candidate is picked with a reason citing its own figures.
assertions: The fuel candidate is not selected
Selected candidate id is in now_candidates
